mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, leading to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of strong GDP growth, or the correlation between GDP and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing and spending, and ultimately positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when the federal funds rate is below 0.1%, or the federal funds rate does not significantly predict S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of low unemployment, or the correlation between unemployment and S&P 500 returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates increased demand for housing and construction materials, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when housing starts are high, or housing starts do not significantly predict S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of high industrial production, or industrial production does not significantly predict S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and inflation (CPI) indicates the monetary policy stance, with low rates and high inflation leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when the federal funds rate is low and inflation is high, or the interaction between the federal funds rate and inflation does not significantly predict S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP and housing starts indicates the strength of the housing market, with high GDP and housing starts leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when GDP and housing starts are high, or the interaction between GDP and housing starts does not significantly predict S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate and high payroll employment indicate a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during periods of economic expansion.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of low unemployment and high payroll employment, or the interaction between unemployment and payroll employment does not significantly predict S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05).
